boundary.selection_reason: Chosen from source delta and shared-shell compatibility before numerical evaluation. DVD2 requires j1=j1prime, j2=j2prime, j3=j3prime and l4=j3prime. This choice also makes the D0 shared auxiliary labels exactly compatible across all B4 factors while j4 differs from j4prime, breaking the fully symmetric boundary.

finite_shell_ranges.dvd2_l4: fixed to j3prime=2 by the exact source delta

source_reductions.dvd2_prefactor: d_i*d_iprime*d_t/d_j3prime = 27/5; source phase is +1 for the frozen integer-spin support

claim_lock: The asymmetric calculation is a held-out boundary robustness test of source-labelled finite shell sums. It is not a refinement map, cylindrical consistency test, continuum limit, bridge, novelty or new physics.
